Authentic Minecraft Aesthetics

Built with pixel-perfect typography (Minecraft Ten, Seven, Five), 3D mechanical press feedback, and tactile bevel shadows.

🎵

Immersive Web Audio Feedback

Embedded memory-cached audio for clicks, button presses, drawer toggles, toast alerts, and level-up XP fanfare.

Learn More →
🧱

Complete OreUI Components

3D buttons, countdown buttons, checkboxes, spring-bounce toggles, segmented sliders, dropdowns, modal dialogs, and shimmer cards.

Powered by VitePress & Vue 3

Lightning-fast client routing, full Markdown component interoperability, dark/light theme support, and responsive layouts.
